    string = input()
    
    # Initialize indices
    a_end = 0
    b_end = 0
    c_end = 0
    
    # Find end of 'A's
    while a_end < len(string) and string[a_end] == 'A':
        a_end += 1
    
    # Find end of 'B's
    b_end = a_end
    while b_end < len(string) and string[b_end] == 'B':
        b_end += 1
